description: Pitre and her husband, Tom, have built their lives around hard work, family values, and helping others. Married for 43 years, they are the parents of three children and grandparents to eight grandchildren. Rebecca’s life experiences—as a mother, homeschool educator, volunteer, musician, coach, and community advocate—have shaped her understanding of the challenges facing working families…
title: About Rebecca – Rebecca Pitre Republican for Lamoille County District 3 Representative
